subtitles.en: Micro is now macro, that's how big this AI company spending has gotten to.

subtitles.en: So one thing that we're paying attention to is CapEx kind of trajectory. I'm not just talking about Nvidia, I'm talking about the whole AI
subtitles.zh: 我们关注资本开支轨迹，不仅英伟达，整个AI生态。

subtitles.en: complex already beginning of the year. It was record level and it has been revised higher and higher CapEx also means competition for capital is intensifying and that pushes rates
subtitles.zh: 年初已创纪录，且不断上调。资本开支增加也加剧资本竞争，推高利率。

subtitles.en: higher as well way in a higher rate environment. But on the flip side of that durable income becomes a more important theme for portfolio, which we're very excited about. But back to
subtitles.zh: 高利率环境下，持久收入成为组合重要主题。回到权益资产，Mac7，标普500低于20倍。

subtitles.en: Aquities, Mac7, you know, we just talked about the S&P 500 trading at below 20 times.
subtitles.zh: Mac7市盈率约23倍，接近三年低点。

subtitles.en: Mac7 for PE is just about 23 times, which is close to a three year low at the moment,
subtitles.zh: 主要因整合轮动及盈利强劲。AI生态中，稀缺卖方表现优于稀缺买方。

subtitles.en: mostly because of what there has been a bit of consolidation rotation but also strength of earnings. So within the broader AI ecosystem, there is a sub thing which is scarcity
subtitles.zh: 英伟达是稀缺卖方，提价显示盈利定价权。

subtitles.en: sellers are doing quite a bit to better than scarcity buyers and Nvidia is scarcity seller. I look at some of the price increase that we have been talking about. It really does
subtitles.zh: 盈利动能令人兴奋。你视之为定价权故事，而非高内存挤压利润。

subtitles.en: show that they have earnings pricing power, earnings momentum and there's something that we're very excited about. That's really interesting. So you see that as a pricing power story of Nvidia,
subtitles.zh: 他们能从容提价，整个AI生态如此。

subtitles.en: not a concern about margin squeeze on higher memory. The read you take from that is they have pricing power. They can do this and do it comfortably. Well, there's the whole AI ecosystem and
subtitles.zh: 这并非对更高内存成本挤压利润的担忧。从中可以看出，他们拥有定价权。他们可以做到这一点，而且游刃有余。此外，还有整个AI生态系统。
